name: 翱翔天际
english_description: A Chinese wuxia/xianxia MUD descended from a classic Journey to the West codebase; its login banner styles it "Soaring Through the Heavens: Grasping the Sun and Drawing the Moon." Players start at the South City Inn, develop five innate attributes, and choose one of four temperaments, then progress through storyline chapters echoing Journey to the West ("Havoc in Heaven," "The Journey for Scriptures") alongside a full sect and alliance system built for long-term character growth.
